affected.note: Includes 615 merchant records. 39,310 records had login IDs, passwords and email addresses; 190 of those also had names, addresses, phone numbers, birthdates and bank account details. A further 5,059 email addresses were affected. Card numbers were not leaked.

summary.en: Credit card company Hokusen suspended its member website after an SQL injection attack on 2022-01-17. An investigation found that 44,559 records of personal data, mostly login credentials and email addresses, may have been leaked.
summary.ja: クレジットカード事業のほくせんは、2022年1月17日に会員向けサイト「ほくせんWebサービス」がSQLインジェクション攻撃を受け、サービスを停止した。調査の結果、ログイン情報やメールアドレスを中心に4万4,559件の個人情報が流出した可能性があると判明した。
